scope: Source-bound exact-zero reconstruction followed by recorded-pose LBS counterfactuals. Nonzero world-Z shoulder descendant rotations preserve the recorded native prescriptions, downstream owners, morphs and transforms; they do not model changed rest binding, posture caps or changed gesture yield.

positiveBound.semantics: Every selected query/target point pair has Euclidean distance at least this downward-rounded AABB lower bound. Any mathematically smaller nonnegative margin is sufficient for the directional criterion. This is not a required product margin, penetration depth or continuous-motion guarantee.

handBoundaryRegions.rule: Every face incident to any positive hand/finger support, union both sides, then strict source-rest x half-space. Includes boundary faces and every legacy face; no weight cutoff. Source-driven scope, not anatomical truth.
